items.name: Custodian package
items.note: Performance schedules supplied; control policies absent [S3]

after.title: Key judgment — total-fund basis is explicit
after.text: The board report states that total-fund returns are net of external manager fees [S1]. This explicit basis supports interpretation of the reported results, although it does not establish how every underlying expense is treated or whether the same convention applies outside the reviewed report.

after.title: Key judgment — policy benchmark is identified
after.text: The investment policy names the benchmark used in the board report [S1, S2]. Matching the two records supports benchmark identity, but the evidence does not by itself establish uninterrupted methodology, approval history, or comparability across every reported period.

after.title: Key judgment — benchmark lineage is incomplete
after.text: The benchmark change is disclosed without an effective date or approval rationale [S1, S2]. That omission prevents period-level lineage testing, so comparability remains bounded until dated approval records identify when the change took effect and why it was adopted.

after.title: Key judgment — control policies are missing
after.text: The custodian package does not include valuation or error-correction policies [S3]. Without those two control records, the review cannot assess how pricing exceptions are resolved or how material reporting errors are identified, approved, corrected and communicated.

items.title: Benchmark date absent
items.detail: The report omits the benchmark-change effective date [S1][S2].

items.title: Valuation policy absent
items.detail: The reviewed package does not include the valuation policy [S3].

after.title: Analysis — benchmark comparability is bounded
after.text: **Observation:** One benchmark change lacks an effective date [S1, S2]. **Why it matters:** Period comparability requires dated benchmark lineage. **Uncertainty:** Approval records supporting the change were not supplied. **What would change the view:** Follow-up request 1 producing dated approval records.

after.title: Analysis — oversight controls are not evidenced
after.text: **Observation:** Two control policies, valuation and error correction, are absent [S3]. **Why it matters:** Reporting oversight cannot be assessed without both policies. **Uncertainty:** The reviewed custodian package may omit separately maintained policies. **What would change the view:** Follow-up request 2 producing approved policy records.

before.title: Oversight evidence by reporting area
before.note: Board-facing evidence status from the fictional review record [S1][S2][S3].

items.q: Provide the benchmark-change effective date, approval record and rationale.
Provide the current valuation and error-correction policies.
